notes:
v0.1.22 — auto-size to your PC + click-to-focus:
- The VM now sizes itself to the host: RAM ~1/3 of physical (2-4GB) and vCPUs ~half the logical cores. On a 6GB / 4-core laptop that's 2GB / 4 vCPUs instead of 4GB / 8 — far lighter, leaves headroom for Windows, same low latency. Override anytime in winmux.toml (ram="2G", smp=4).
- Terminal latency is already near the WHPX floor (~3ms); this release is about footprint on weak machines.
- Fix: clicking the empty area under the prompt now focuses the terminal and jumps to the bottom.
